M3 — 2026-11-16
vitest CLI `--exclude` does not reach the unit project's own exclude list in vitest.config.ts. To leave files out of a run, set `SOFAR_TEST_EXCLUDE=<path>,<path>` (ci-speed 2.1). `vitest list` ignores --shard. To check what a shard covers, run it with `--reporter=json --outputFile`.
